issues.problem: 按 dek 和 hook.1 的界定，标题“两条”包括士兵马骡。可是士兵马骡从未写进条文，也不是写到一半想起的，而是李提出后格兰特口头准许的。写到一半想起的两项实为军官私马私物和军官佩刀（E15）。

evidence.quote: As I wrote on, the thought occurred to me that the officers had their own private horses and effects
as the terms were written they would not

issues.proposed: 保留标题。dek 与 hook.1 中“两条”须改为指军官的私马私物和佩刀，不含士兵马骡。

issues.problem: dek 称士兵马骡“不是谈出来的”、是格兰特写条文时加进去的。实际上这一项由李提出询问，条文并未包含，格兰特只是口头指示留守军官放行。

evidence.quote: he asked if he was to understand that the men who so owned their horses were to be permitted to retain them
I would, therefore, instruct the officers I left behind to receive the paroles of his troops

issues.proposed: 改为：军官的佩刀与私马私物是格兰特写条文时自行加入的；士兵的马骡则是李问起后，格兰特口头准许的，未写入条文。中英同改。

issues.problem: 中文用「」标出的「8日」不是证据中的逐字片段，原文为 the 8th。

evidence.quote: On the 8th I had followed the Army of the Potomac

issues.proposed: 去掉引号，写作“8日”；或写作「the 8th」。

issues.problem: 中文“跟在李的军队后面行进”漏掉了原文主语：格兰特跟随的是波托马克军，而该军位于李军之后。英文保留了这一点，中英不一致。

evidence.quote: I had followed the Army of the Potomac in rear of Lee

issues.proposed: 改为“格兰特跟着在李军后方的波托马克军行进”。

issues.problem: “也就在这一天，李送来一封信”在证据中没有依据。E2 只说会面拟定在“to-day”上午十点，没有说明这封信与 8 日是同一天。

evidence.quote: the meeting proposed for ten A.M. to-day could lead to no good

issues.proposed: 删去“也就在这一天/That same day”，改为“李来信提议会面”。

issues.problem: 中文删去了“数亿（hundreds of millions）”财产的数字，英文保留了，中英不一致。

evidence.quote: save thousands of human lives and hundreds of millions of property not yet destroyed

issues.proposed: 中文改为“救下成千上万条人命和数以亿计尚未被毁的财产”。

issues.problem: 文中称士兵马骡是“落笔之后才想起来加进去的”，与证据不符。条文写成后并不允许士兵带走马匹，此项是李询问后格兰特口头准许的。

evidence.quote: I told him that as the terms were written they would not; that only the officers were permitted to take their private property

issues.proposed: 改为：落笔时才想起写入的是军官的佩刀和私马私物；士兵的马骡是李提出后格兰特口头准许的，未写入条文。中英同改。

issues.problem: 标题中的“白旗”“两小时停火”在证据包中均无依据。
issues.proposed: 改为如“停火疑虑与绕路的信”。

issues.problem: “李求见的目的不是交出军队”替李给动机下了定性。证据只有格兰特说自己无权谈和；E11 记李来是为取得格兰特拟给其军队的条件。

evidence.quote: As I have no authority to treat on the subject of peace
he had asked for this interview for the purpose of getting from me the terms I proposed to give his army

issues.proposed: 删去该判断，改为“格兰特回信说自己无权谈和……”。

issues.problem: 稿件把“送得很费劲”说成是格兰特那封拒绝会面的回信。证据中难送达的是李后来送给格兰特的信，原因是格兰特走的路线。中英两版混淆了两封信的先后与收发方向。

evidence.quote: from the route I had taken, they would probably not be able to communicate with me and get an answer back within the time fixed

issues.proposed: 改为：李再次来信时，因格兰特改走另一条路，信使难以按时联系到他并带回答复。

issues.problem: “李打出白旗”不见于证据包。
issues.proposed: 删去。

issues.problem: “只同意停火两小时”这一时长不见于证据。E3 只说两位指挥官对是否停火非常犹豫。

evidence.quote: both of these commanders hesitated very considerably about suspending hostilities at all

issues.proposed: 删去“两小时”这一句。

issues.problem: “李于是派卫队护送”把派人护送写成停火犹豫的结果。原文给出的原因是格兰特所走的路线导致信使难以按时往返。英文“an escort of his own guard”也多于原文的“an escort”。

evidence.quote: Lee, therefore, sent an escort with the officer bearing this message through his lines to me

issues.proposed: 写明因路线原因，李派人护送信使穿过己方战线；英文改为“sent an escort”。

issues.problem: “部队已列阵迎敌 / already formed for battle”不见于证据。E7 只说他们情绪激动、认为是诡计。

evidence.quote: They were very much excited, and expressed their view that this was all a ruse

issues.proposed: 删去“已列阵迎敌”。

issues.problem: 李“一身全新军装、佩一柄贵重的剑”不见于证据。E9 只写了格兰特本人的穿着。
issues.proposed: 删去该句（中英）。

issues.problem: 格兰特口述条件时加了“对美利坚政府作战 / against the Government of the United States”，这是从 E14 的书面条款挪来的。E12 原话没有这一项。

evidence.quote: not to take them up again during the continuance of the war unless duly and properly exchanged

issues.proposed: 删去“对美利坚政府作战/against the Government of the United States”。

issues.problem: “叙旧 / talked about old times”在证据包中没有出处。E11 只说谈话很愉快，没有说明内容。

evidence.quote: Our conversation grew so pleasant that I almost forgot the object of our meeting

issues.proposed: 改为“两人先闲谈，谈得很愉快，格兰特几乎忘了此行目的”。

issues.problem: “武器、炮兵和公物”把 artillery 误译为炮兵（人员），原文指火炮。

evidence.quote: The arms, artillery and public property to be parked and stacked

issues.proposed: 改为“武器、火炮和公物”。

issues.problem: 英文把格兰特的间接转述“this would have a happy effect upon his army”加引号，呈现为李的原话。从“his army”可见这是格兰特的转述，不是李的直接引语。

evidence.quote: he remarked, with some feeling, I thought, that this would have a happy effect upon his army

issues.proposed: 去掉引号，改为间接引语：he remarked … that this would have a happy effect upon his army。

issues.problem: 中文漏掉英文中的两处内容：李对最初条件似无异议、或想等写成文字再提；以及格兰特说若漏写而李提出，他也会照样加入。

evidence.quote: He appeared to have no objections to the terms first proposed
If I had happened to omit it, and General Lee had called my attention to it, I should have put it in the terms

issues.proposed: 中文补上这两句的译述。

issues.problem: “李再次说，这会有良好影响 / Lee again said this would have a happy effect”在证据中没有依据。李的这句评价只见于他读到军官佩刀私物那一段时（E16），E17–E18 之后没有这样的记录。

evidence.quote: When he read over that part of the terms about side arms, horses and private property of the officers

issues.proposed: 删去该句（中英）。

issues.problem: 中文漏掉英文中格兰特的旁注：李的说法仍暗含南北为两个国家。

evidence.quote: still maintaining by implication that we were two countries

issues.proposed: 中文补上“（格兰特注意到，这话仍暗指双方是两个国家）”。

issues.problem: “他8日那封信 / his letter of the 8th”读来像是李自己的信。E19 是李写给格兰特的，“your letter”指格兰特 8 日的信。

evidence.quote: As they are substantially the same as those expressed in your letter of the 8th inst., they are accepted

issues.proposed: 改为“与格兰特8日来信中所提的实质相同 / those expressed in Grant's letter of the 8th”。

issues.problem: “两人在两军阵线之间骑马会面 / rode together between the lines”不见于证据。E23 只有“in the course of which”，没有说明会面的地点和方式。

evidence.quote: in the course of which Lee said to me that the South was a big country

issues.proposed: 删去“在两军阵线之间骑马”，改为“第二天两人交谈时”。

issues.problem: 英文“not to be the cause of more loss”误译。原文的意思是希望北军（we）不必再被迫造成更多伤亡，不是李自己不愿成为起因。中文译法无误，中英不一致。

evidence.quote: that we would not be called upon to cause more loss and sacrifice of life

issues.proposed: 改为“he earnestly hoped the Union would not be called upon to cause more loss and sacrifice of life”。

issues.problem: 中文“不经总统同意”把原文的 consulting（先征询）写成了 consent（同意），意思偏强。

evidence.quote: he could not do that without consulting the President first

issues.proposed: 改为“不先征询总统，他不能那样做”。

issues.problem: 同 F18，“武器、炮兵和公物”把 artillery 误译为炮兵。

evidence.quote: The arms, artillery and public property

issues.proposed: 改为“武器、火炮和公物”。

inherited.rationale: 问题成立，即 F4。原文是跟随位于李军之后的波托马克军；中文漏掉了波托马克军。修改建议的措辞“李军之前”不准确，应按 F4 修改。

evidence.quote: I had followed the Army of the Potomac in rear of Lee

inherited.rationale: 问题成立，即 F7。士兵马骡未写入条文，是口头准许。

evidence.quote: as the terms were written they would not

inherited.rationale: 问题成立，即 F11。证据中没有白旗。
问题成立，即 F12。证据中没有两小时这一时长。

evidence.quote: hesitated very considerably about suspending hostilities at all
for the purpose of getting from me the terms I proposed to give his army

inherited.rationale: 问题成立，即 F15。E9 只写了格兰特的衣着。

evidence.quote: that this would have a happy effect upon his army
those expressed in your letter of the 8th inst.
